spans.text: We have confirmed that the Griffin Commander has escaped the interrogation room. At the same time, the building is currently under attack by Griffin T-Dolls. Initiate the backup plan immediately.
Attention, all Nytos. Kill all hostile units attempting to leave the building and destroy all hostile forces approaching the facility.
Miss Kalina, we've successfully rescued Commander, but the entire building's on maximum alert.
More enemies are approaching the building, and my squad alone will not be enough to make it out of this facility.
We need you to wipe out the enemies ASAP and give us a chance to escape!
Griffins, the enemy leader has shown herself. Move out!
We're in position! Ready to intercept at any time!
Defense line established! I won't let them get near this building!
Signal conditions are clear. You won't have to worry about losing reception.
We're defending the HOCs, don't worry!
Can we start now? This is my first overt mission, so I'll obey directions.
Let's fuck 'em up! This is the Highway to Hell!
Alright! Everyone, it's time to bring Commander home!
Keep the enemies away from the building at all costs! Ensure UMP45 and the others can escort the Commander back!
The battle will be a long one, but we'll be the winners!
Everyone, hold the line, for Griffin and the Commander!
